description: One kind of Account for one wallet, in full: balance, lifetime earnings, unclaimed rewards, APY, status, whether a newer version exists or it is the earlier MAMO Account — or, for the stocks portfolio, NAV, cash, positions against targets and fee due. Answers a LIST: a wallet can hold two of a kind. `fresh: true` right after a confirmed transaction.

address.description: The wallet address that owns the Account, 0x-prefixed, on Base.

fresh.description: Bypass the cache; only right after a confirmed transaction.

verbose.description: Include the raw indexer figures behind the Account.

name: get_user_account
title: Inspect one Mamo Account for a wallet
